content.value_statement: Cloud teams often waste budget through idle resources, weak tagging, and mismatched pricing models. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code plan practical cost controls across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
actual_capabilities: Explains a cost optimization framework covering visibility, rightsizing, pricing, architecture, and monitoring.
Summarizes AWS, Azure, and GCP discount options and common workload fit.
Provides Terraform examples for lifecycle policies, tagging, budgets, and autoscaling.
Offers a checklist for ongoing cloud cost governance and review cycles.
Lists cloud cost tools for analysis, anomaly detection, and provider recommendations.
limitations: Does not calculate savings from live cloud account data.
Provider pricing and discount percentages may change by region and date.
Terraform examples require review before production deployment.
Does not replace finance, compliance, or capacity planning approval.

use_cases.title: Reduce Monthly Cloud Spend
use_cases.description: Identify idle resources, oversized services, and pricing changes that can lower recurring infrastructure costs.

use_cases.title: Plan Tagging And Budget Controls
use_cases.description: Create a cost allocation approach that improves reporting, accountability, and budget alert coverage.

use_cases.title: Compare Commitment Options
use_cases.description: Evaluate reserved capacity, savings plans, and committed use discounts for steady workloads.

prompt_templates.title: Find Quick Savings
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a cloud bill or resource list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this cloud cost summary and list the safest first steps to reduce spend without affecting reliability.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Tagging Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Create cost allocation standards for teams and projects.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a tagging strategy for our cloud resources. Include required tags, ownership rules, reporting needs, and governance checks.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Pricing Models
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare reserved instances, savings plans, spot capacity, and committed use discounts for these workloads and risk constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Governance Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 90-day cloud cost governance roadmap across AWS, Azure, and GCP with metrics, owners, review cadence, and controls.

output_examples.input: Review my monthly cloud spend and propose first actions.
output: Start with idle resources, unattached storage, and oversized compute because they usually carry low migration risk.
Add budget alerts and anomaly detection before larger pricing commitments.
Review steady workloads for reserved capacity after utilization data is stable.

output_examples.input: Help me explain cost tagging requirements to application teams.
output: Require owner, environment, application, cost center, and data sensitivity tags on every supported resource.
Use reports to show untagged spend by team and service.
Add deployment checks so missing tags are fixed before resources reach production.

output_examples.input: Plan storage cost reductions for data with different access patterns.
output: Keep frequently used data in standard storage.
Move older data to infrequent access and archive tiers after business retention review.
Confirm restore time and compliance needs before enabling expiration policies.

best_practices: Review utilization data before rightsizing production resources.
Use budget alerts and anomaly detection before major architecture changes.
Confirm retention, reliability, and compliance requirements before deleting or archiving data.
anti_patterns: Buying long-term commitments before workload demand is stable.
Applying lifecycle expiration rules without business owner approval.
Measuring savings without tracking performance, reliability, and support impact.

faq.question: Which cloud providers does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers AWS, Azure, and GCP cost optimization patterns, with some multi-cloud governance guidance.

faq.question: Does it connect to cloud accounts?
faq.answer: No. It provides analysis guidance and examples, but it does not access live billing or resource data.

faq.question: Can I use the Terraform examples directly?
faq.answer: Treat them as starting points. Review names, regions, retention rules, permissions, and business impact before deployment.

faq.question: Is this useful for FinOps work?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports tagging, budgets, anomaly detection, rightsizing, and commitment planning for FinOps workflows.

faq.question: Does it estimate exact savings?
faq.answer: No. It explains likely savings areas, but exact results require current pricing, usage, and contract data.

faq.question: What should teams check before reducing costs?
faq.answer: Check reliability targets, data retention needs, performance baselines, compliance rules, and workload ownership.
